claims.meaning: The work visualizes a read-only snapshot of locally readable Ordivon Git repository identities and exact observed HEAD revisions at creation time.
allowedWording: The work visualizes a read-only snapshot of locally readable Ordivon Git repository identities and exact observed HEAD revisions at creation time.
avoid: It does not claim repository completeness beyond the declared selection, currentness after the observation time, runtime health, task priority, dependency structure, or organizational authority.

claims.meaning: Point coordinates are deterministic compositional positions used to make a cartographic artwork and a queryable vector dataset.
allowedWording: Point coordinates are deterministic compositional positions used to make a cartographic artwork and a queryable vector dataset.
avoid: Coordinates are not geographic locations and distances are not dependency, importance, ownership, or causal measurements.
